name: Proto-Vanikoro
notes: Teanu, Lovono and Tanema. François (2009: 5-6) argues for it from the paragogic vowel, *t > k before u and lexical innovations (Table 2), against Ross & Næss (2007: 473), for whom 'no innovations define Vanikoro'; Lackey & Boerger (2021: 383-388) give a set of ordered shared changes ((103), Table 3). Not in the main tree (decision temotu-tree); no Glottolog clade (Glottolog has Utupua-Vanikoro only).
